summary: Iteration 21 backend bug-fix regression complete. 5/5 pytest tests PASSED for the daybook invoice cash/online split + grand_total math rewrite. Verified: (1) creating an invoice with total=₹5000, cash_amount=3000, online_amount=2000 causes GET /api/daybook to reflect exact +3000/+2000/+5000 deltas on invoices.cash/online/total AND on grand_total.cash/online/total; (2) legacy invoice (inserted directly via Mongo with no cash_amount/online_amount/payment_mode fields) is treated as all-cash by daybook aggregation (cash+=total, online+=0); (3) daybook grand_total math is correct across mixed sources — 1 invoice (3000/2000) + 1 collection (1000/500) + 1 standalone 'other' receipt (200/100) yields grand_total.cash=4200, online=2600, total=6800 as expected; (4) daily_sales section is NOT touched/double-counted by grand_total when no daily_sales doc is created; (5) daybook response shape intact — due_collection/daily_sales/receipts/invoices each expose cash/online/total/entries and total_collection breakdown card still has daily_sales/invoices/due_collection/money_receipts/grand_total, all numeric and matching each section's total. Also re-ran iteration_20 regression suite (12/12 PASSED) — invoice-no-sale + split behaviour unchanged.

rca_of_issue: Pre-fix: daybook endpoint aggregated invoices.total but hardcoded cash=0/online=0, so the daybook UI showed ₹0 cash / ₹0 online under Invoices even when invoices had legitimate cash+online splits. Additionally, grand_total previously summed daily_sales (physical cash count) + collections + receipts which double-counted collections against employee-side cash. Fix (server.py L1927-1994): (a) read invoice.cash_amount / invoice.online_amount and fall back to payment_mode for legacy docs, (b) rewrite grand_total to sum collections.cash + invoices.cash + standalone-'other'-receipts.cash (and same for online), explicitly excluding daily_sales (now positioned as cash-verification/physical count) and receipts linked to sale/invoice/collection (informational to avoid double count). Verified via 5 focused daybook delta tests using snapshot-before / snapshot-after pattern to insulate from any pre-existing rows for TODAY.
